description: This file defines an Angular standalone component 'BottomNavComponent' which implements a mobile bottom navigation bar with links to Home, Categories, Cart, and Profile. It includes embedded template and styles, and interacts with a CartService to display the item count in the cart.

classes.name: BottomNavComponent
classes.description: Angular component for the bottom navigation bar tailored for mobile viewports. Uses dependency injection to access CartService for cart item count, renders navigation links with icons and badge.

methods.name: get count$
methods.description: Getter method returning observable stream of cart item count from the injected CartService, used for the cart badge display.
